description: Find entities: one row each with entity_id, name, state, unit and area, in entity id order. Filter by domain (light, sensor, climate, ...), by area (its name or id), and by words that must all appear in the id, the name or the area. Use it to find the entity_id other tools take; get_states reads an entity's attributes.

area.description: Only entities in this area, by its name or id (list_areas lists them).

domain.description: Only entities of this domain, like light or sensor.

search.description: Words that must all appear in the entity id, its name or its area, ignoring case.

name: list_entities
title: List entities
